name: WWU Padden Invitational
where: Bellingham, WA · host Western Washington · Lake Padden Park
headline: WWU Padden Invitational
summary: Final: Trinity Western won the men's 8K with 30 points to No. 10 Western Washington's 37, going 1-2 with Justin Kiplagat (24:35.7) and David Mutai (24:52.8). No. 21 Western Washington's women won with 19 points over Simon Fraser (52), led by Ella Edens in 20:54.1 and Josephine Stevenson in 21:48.8.
